subcategories.name: Bags

fitted_underwear.bust.label: Bust range by actual band/cup combination
fitted_underwear.bust.guidance: Explicit units and measurement basis; never calculate a cup from an unverified conversion.

fitted_underwear.cup.label: Cup labels and bust fit guidance
fitted_underwear.cup.guidance: Cup systems are not universally equivalent; link actual band/cup combinations and known guidance.

fitted_underwear.kind.label: Actual garment type
fitted_underwear.kind.guidance: Brief, bra, bodysuit or other actual construction selects the relevant fit fields.

fitted_underwear.waist_hips.label: Waist and hip fit by size

requirement.when: when a lower-body garment is sold

fitted_underwear.waist_hips.guidance: Separate waist and hips, units and basis; record actual combination-specific values.

footwear.closure.label: Fastening and intended use
footwear.closure.guidance: Describe actual closure and use without unsupported safety/performance claims.

footwear.colour.label: Colours and valid size combinations
footwear.colour.guidance: Real variant matrix with separate price and stock references.

footwear.length.label: Foot or internal length by size
footwear.length.guidance: Clearly distinguish foot length from shoe internal length and label units.

footwear.system.label: Shoe size system and labels
footwear.system.guidance: EU, UK, US or merchant system as actually labelled; no invented cross-system equivalence.

footwear.width.label: Width or width fitting by size
footwear.width.guidance: Use actual width scale or measured width with unit.

fulfilment.coverage.label: Service area and pickup locations

requirement.when: when physical delivery or customer-location service is offered

fulfilment.coverage.guidance: Exact authoritative coverage; show eligibility for the selected customer location.

fulfilment.instructions.label: Customer-facing fulfilment instructions
fulfilment.instructions.guidance: Public instructions exclude personal access credentials and internal notes.

fulfilment.lead_time.label: Preparation or fulfilment lead time
fulfilment.lead_time.guidance: Exact amount and unit; estimate versus firm promise must be labelled.

fulfilment.methods.label: Delivery, pickup, visit or remote methods
fulfilment.methods.guidance: Only supported methods for the selected listing and location.

garment_scope.construction.label: Garment construction
garment_scope.construction.guidance: Upper body, lower body, dress/full-body or explicitly listed set. This selects relevant measurement groups.

garment_scope.pieces.label: Included garments and size selection

requirement.when: when a set or coordinated outfit is sold

garment_scope.pieces.guidance: Keep each piece's fit chart and valid set combinations; a jacket size does not determine a trouser size.

gift.contents.label: Included items and quantities
gift.contents.guidance: Link actual components, size/quantity and possible substitutions.

gift.occasion.label: Occasion and style descriptors
gift.occasion.guidance: Discovery descriptors, not substitute product specifications.

gift.personalization.label: Message or personalization choices
gift.personalization.guidance: Allowed lengths/formats and proof approval; recipient messages stay private to the order.

hat.circumference.label: Head circumference range by size
hat.circumference.guidance: Body fit range and length unit; one-size requires actual guidance or an explicit not-provided state.

necklace.length.label: Chain length and adjustment range
necklace.length.guidance: Known chain length with units; do not confuse doubled chain length with wearing drop.

necklace.pendant.label: Pendant dimensions and included pieces
necklace.pendant.guidance: Explicit units and whether a photographed pendant/chain is included.

outerwear.features.label: Hood, pockets and fastening
outerwear.features.guidance: Declared features; performance claims need confirmed supporting information.

outerwear.layers.label: Lining, insulation and intended layers
outerwear.layers.guidance: Describe actual construction and fit allowance.

price.amount.label: Published price or quote status
price.amount.guidance: Money uses integer minor units and currency; quote-only is not a zero price. Never auto-convert legacy whole-KES fields.

price.basis.label: How the price is calculated
price.basis.guidance: Fixed, per declared unit, variant, duration, person, package, starting estimate or quote-only.

price.charges.label: Included and additional charges
price.charges.guidance: Explicit unit, applicability, inclusions and source; show the selected total before commitment.

price.policy.label: Price and policy version
price.policy.guidance: Accepted work retains the applicable version; prices come from their declared authority.

request.contact.label: Customer contact for this request
request.contact.guidance: Use authorized customer/contact records and purpose-limited access.

request.place_time.label: Relevant location, dates and quantities

requirement.when: when needed for the selected service

request.place_time.guidance: Only applicable fields; exact private addresses and access details remain restricted.

request.scope.label: Requested work and preferences

requirement.when: when a quote or assessment is needed

request.scope.guidance: Collect only information needed to scope this request; never place it in public specifications.

ring.fit.label: Internal diameter or circumference by size
ring.fit.guidance: Exact measurement meaning, unit and actual size row; adjustable rings state a known range.

ring.stone.label: Stone, setting and declared metal specification
ring.stone.guidance: Actual gemstone/plating/metal claims and source; do not infer authenticity or purity.

ring.system.label: Ring size labels and system
ring.system.guidance: Preserve the actual merchant system; no unverified international conversion.

ring.width.label: Band width and setting dimensions
ring.width.guidance: Separate band width from ring diameter; explicit units.

sale.condition.label: Item condition
sale.condition.guidance: New, used or refurbished as applicable; explain the actual grading when relevant.

sale.returns.label: Applicable return and warranty references
sale.returns.guidance: Reference the effective policy; inherited policies require explicit scope and overrides.

sale.unit.label: Sale unit and pack quantity
sale.unit.guidance: Explicit count, weight or volume unit, precision and contents per sale unit.

sale.variants.label: Actual purchasable combinations

requirement.when: when options change the purchased item

sale.variants.guidance: Stable variant IDs; list actual combinations, never an automatic size-by-colour cross-product.

scarf.dimensions.label: Length and width
scarf.dimensions.guidance: Named dimensions and unit; distinguish fringe from body length where relevant.

scarf.finish.label: Edges, fringe and construction
scarf.finish.guidance: Actual product construction and included pieces.

schedule.availability.label: Available dates, times or capacity
schedule.availability.guidance: Derived from the actual authority, resource eligibility and current capacity; unknown is distinct from unavailable.

schedule.intake.label: How acceptance works
schedule.intake.guidance: Use the effective model's allowed intake mode; a request is not a confirmed reservation.

schedule.rules.label: Lead time, buffers and booking horizon
schedule.rules.guidance: Use exact configured rules with Kenya time; preserve local dates separately from instants.

service.cancellation.label: Cancellation, reschedule and no-show terms
service.cancellation.guidance: Use applicable authority and version; no universal thresholds are invented here.

service.duration.label: Service duration and unit
service.duration.guidance: Exact duration when bookable; assessment-required is explicit and cannot promise a slot.

service.methods.label: Service location or format
service.methods.guidance: Merchant venue, customer location or remote where explicitly configured.

service.preparation.label: Customer preparation and prerequisites
service.preparation.guidance: Merchant-approved administrative instructions; no generated clinical or professional advice.

service.provider.label: Eligible provider or resource description

requirement.when: when resources or staff are needed

service.provider.guidance: Public provider details are an allowed projection; internal staffing records remain private.

service.scope.label: What the service includes and excludes
service.scope.guidance: Define the actual task or deliverables and any assessment boundary.

shirt.chest.label: Chest or bust by size
shirt.chest.guidance: Label whether body or garment and flat width or circumference.

shirt.collar.label: Collar or neckline style
shirt.collar.guidance: Actual construction, not an inferred style.

shirt.fastening.label: Fastening or closure
shirt.fastening.guidance: Actual button, zip, pull-on or other construction.

requirement.when: when the construction has a defined shoulder

shirt.sleeve.label: Sleeve length by size

requirement.when: when sleeves are present and this measure applies

shirt.sleeve.guidance: State how the sleeve was measured.

shirt.sleeve_style.label: Sleeve style
shirt.sleeve_style.guidance: Short, long, sleeveless or actual supported type.

shoe_extra.care.label: Care and material-specific instructions
shoe_extra.care.guidance: Use confirmed product instructions and accessible text.

shoe_extra.closure.label: Fastening
shoe_extra.closure.guidance: Laces, buckle, zip, slip-on or actual construction.

shoe_extra.fit.label: Merchant fit notes
shoe_extra.fit.guidance: Specific guidance such as width/instep allowance with its source; no automatic size recommendation.

shoe_extra.shape.label: Toe shape and shoe style
shoe_extra.shape.guidance: Actual footwear shape/style; sizes still use the named system.

sizing.basis.label: Measurement basis and units

requirement.when: when a measurement chart is supplied

sizing.basis.guidance: Body versus garment, circumference versus flat width, cm versus inches; never infer a universal conversion between size labels.

sizing.rows.label: Chart rows for actual sizes
sizing.rows.guidance: Reference an accurate versioned chart or item-specific rows; each size has separate values/ranges and measurement instructions.

sizing.system.label: Size labels and sizing system
sizing.system.guidance: Preserve merchant labels and named system; one-size still needs fit guidance.

smartwatch.battery.label: Battery capacity and charging
smartwatch.battery.guidance: Rated capacity, charging method and included charger; no invented runtime.

smartwatch.compatibility.label: Compatible phone systems and required app
smartwatch.compatibility.guidance: Actual supported versions, region/network limits and subscription needs where relevant.

smartwatch.display.label: Display type and size
smartwatch.display.guidance: Actual display dimensions/resolution with units where needed.

smartwatch.features.label: Confirmed connectivity and activity features
smartwatch.features.guidance: Manufacturer-described features; no inferred clinical accuracy or diagnosis.

smartwatch.model.label: Exact smartwatch model and case version
smartwatch.model.guidance: Actual generation, case dimensions and promised model; not a generic smart-home device.

stock.availability.label: Availability by variant and location
stock.availability.guidance: Reference authoritative stock and unit; a merchant's shop hours are not proof of stock.

stock.mode.label: Stock control mode
stock.mode.guidance: Internal, external, hybrid or explicitly disabled. Unknown stock must remain unknown.

tailoring.fittings.label: Included fittings, revisions and acceptance
tailoring.fittings.guidance: Appointment scheduling is separately configured; do not invent a confirmed fitting from a production request.

tailoring.materials.label: Who supplies fabric and materials
tailoring.materials.guidance: Merchant-supplied, customer-supplied or agreed after assessment; state inclusions and extra charges.

tailoring.measurement_method.label: Measurement or fitting method
tailoring.measurement_method.guidance: In-person fitting, submitted measurements or reference garment only if actually supported.

tailoring.task.label: Made-to-measure, alteration or garment task
tailoring.task.guidance: Choose the actual garment and supported task; an assessment may precede price/due acceptance.

watch.case.label: Case dimensions
watch.case.guidance: Case diameter, width and thickness as relevant, each with units; materials are captured separately.

watch.features.label: Functions and stated resistance rating
watch.features.guidance: Reproduce confirmed manufacturer ratings without inferring a safe activity.

watch.movement.label: Movement and power type
watch.movement.guidance: Mechanical, quartz, rechargeable or actual specified type.

watch_extra.care.label: Care, warranty and service information
watch_extra.care.guidance: Confirmed product care; manufacturer rating alone does not imply a safe activity.

watch_extra.case_material.label: Case and glass materials
watch_extra.case_material.guidance: Materials are separate from the numeric case dimensions.

watch_extra.strap_material.label: Strap or bracelet material
watch_extra.strap_material.guidance: Identify material, finish and replaceability where known.

watch_extra.strap_width.label: Strap width
watch_extra.strap_width.guidance: Known lug/strap width with unit; do not infer replacement compatibility.

watch_extra.wrist.label: Wrist fit range
watch_extra.wrist.guidance: Explicit wrist circumference range/unit and adjustable link/buckle scope.

customerSections.label: Delivery or collection
customerSections.behavior: Show actual location eligibility, lead time and permitted methods from their authority.

customerSections.label: Care, returns and service terms
customerSections.behavior: Display applicable care, returns, warranty or tailoring/styling terms before commitment.

customerSections.label: Service scheduling
customerSections.behavior: Only relevant for actual styling/fitting appointments or configured production promises; product stock is separate.

customerSections.label: Private tailoring request

screenImpacts.effect: Show accepted garment/variant, piece, colour/size and chart/policy snapshot; private tailoring inputs only to authorized staff. Preserve product orders versus fitting appointments and accepted production work.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-WK01: an accepted dress order retains the selected size, colour, variant ID and accepted chart/price/policy versions after the merchant edits the current chart. A viewer without tailoring access cannot open personal measurements.

screenImpacts.effect: Specific item selection, grouped fashion fields, real variants and units, size charts, scoped defaults, customer preview and missing-information review.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-OF01: choose Dress, enter its applicable construction fields, create real size/colour variants, attach a size guide with units/basis, then inspect each variant in Customer preview. A skirt omits inseam; a ring uses its ring-size guide; changing type reviews incompatible saved fields.

screenImpacts.effect: Variant/branch stock for products; separate fitting/styling appointment resources and production/due capacity for tailoring. A product does not gain an appointment calendar.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-AV01: size M at one branch can be unavailable while size L or another branch differs. A styling appointment uses provider/time capacity; purchasing the dress never consumes a fitting slot.

screenImpacts.effect: Maintain brand/maker defaults, location applicability, shared versioned charts and public policy references without treating merchant specialty as a restriction on actual offerings.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-BU01: updating a shared chart previews affected listings and preserves explicit item/variant overrides. A shop can add an applicable offering without changing its primary merchant identity.

screenImpacts.effect: Use accepted variant/quantity/extra prices, applicable policy versions and authoritative refund facts; size-chart edits never rewrite historical charges.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-MO01: a different price for a real variant is reflected in the accepted order and applicable refund calculation. A later chart or current-price edit does not change that historical amount.

screenImpacts.effect: Target real eligible variants and locations, accurately show from/selected price and stock-dependent eligibility, and preserve the correct colour image.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-PR01: a promotion restricted to specified variants/branches shows the right image, price basis and actual eligibility. It does not advertise an unavailable size as available or apply to an excluded variant.

screenImpacts.effect: Allow meaningful item/type/variant dimensions where source data exists; missing size, stock or fit-return reasons remain unavailable rather than inferred.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-IN01: report only known item/type/variant dimensions with declared data coverage. Missing fit-return reasons are unavailable; they are not inferred from size or a customer's body.

screenImpacts.effect: Declare source/edit ownership for product details, chart versions, prices and stock; map imported size/colour/measurement fields and restrict private tailoring access.
screenImpacts.acceptanceScenario: FASH-SE01: an imported size/chart maps its actual system, units and measurement basis. Conflicting source-owned values enter review; external prices/stock remain under their owner and private tailoring fields remain restricted.

reviewQuestions: Which measurements should block publication for each garment type, and when is a clear not-provided state acceptable?
Which existing merchant size charts can be reused accurately, and who maintains updates and exceptions?
Are the proposed construction choices and separate ring, necklace, bracelet, earring and smartwatch templates sufficient for the actual ranges?
